column1: # machorun fixture manifest -- tab separated, one runnable fixture per line.
# id            fixture id; tests/bin/<id> is the Mach-O, tests/expected/<id>.*
# rung          position on the ladder in docs/FIXTURES.md (a..i)
# oracle        run                 macOS can execute it, so a baseline exists
#               norun:<reason>      macOS refuses to execute it; no baseline,
# linux         pass                should eventually match the oracle exactly
# Columns are separated by a single TAB. Keep it that way; the harness splits
# on tabs so descriptions may contain spaces.
